scope: Bounded independent read-only source/evidence triage; no browser rerun, product edit, account/network/system action

inventory.limitation: 774 component catalogue is inventory. Header-only PASS/source mapping may overstate executed coverage; no new coverage promoted.

summary.note: No recorded pageErrors in125 synthetic cases is scoped evidence, not absence of every product bug.

measurement.finding: First descendant .Transition_slide-active is nested Loading or RightHeader; text/body is measured differently from whole-surface controls. Fixed900ms delay does not prove settled route.

settingsBody.finding: Transition id=Settings + shouldWrap: direct active child is selected route body.

rightBody.finding: RightHeader followed by direct body Transition without shouldWrap: active child is routed component root.

embeddedPrivacy.finding: PhoneP2P is subsection of PrivacyPhoneCall; AddByPhone under PrivacyPhoneNumber only visibility=nobody. No direct standalone branch.

foldersMissing.finding: Reducer folderId not in global.chatFolders.byId causes isRemoved; effect123 resets.

folderActions.finding: Create reset; filter editIncludeFilters/editExcludeFilters; share also initializes tab.shareFolderScreen.

folderEntry.finding: openEditChatFolder requires actual selectChatFolder; share entry establishes exact panel.

membersLocal.finding: selectedChatMemberId local state set by handleSelectChatMember270; direct global enum cannot seed target.

managementInitial.finding: if(nextManagementScreen) does not consume Initial=0. Old local screen may persist; use actual reset/navigation, wait body. This is not a proved runtime exception.

managementBranches.finding: No GroupType or GroupRecentActions body branch; GroupType offered action opens ChatPrivacyType.

disabledEventLog.finding: EventLog ListItem explicitly disabled and lacks click handler.

selectorBranches.finding: Right NewGroup has no panel branch; group creation is LeftColumn workflow.

passkeys.finding: Undefined passkeys gives intro/create; active defined[] resets; saved row needs nonempty array.

customEmoji.finding: Needs customEmojis.added.setIds defined; populated sets in stickers.setsById.

pollBody.finding: Loading unless message/poll/chat; undefined if resultByOption absent.

topicBody.finding: Selected topic must exist in chats.topicsInfoById[chatId].topicsById.

statisticsBody.finding: Actual tab statistics payload needed; header h3 is insufficient.

settings:PrivacyAddByPhone: Audit PhoneNumber with visibility=nobody and assert subsection.
settings:PrivacyPhoneP2P: Audit PhoneCall and assert P2P subsection.
management:GroupType: Use actual GroupType action; expect ChatPrivacyType.
management:GroupRecentActions: Report disabled EventLog/source feature gap; do not fabricate body.
right:NewGroup: Use LeftColumn NewGroupStep1/2 without creation submission.

settings:FoldersCreateFolder: Use reducer reset for Create; do not preselect editFolder2.
settings:FoldersEditFolder: Seed chatFolders.byId[2], orderedIds,invites[2]; use actual edit.
settings:FoldersEditFolderFromChatList: Seed actual folder and openEditChatFolder entry.
settings:FoldersShare: Seed folder and shareFolderScreen through actual share action.
settings:CustomEmoji: Define added.setIds; populated set requires matching setsById row.
management:GroupUserPermissions: Click actual synthetic picker/member row to set local target.
management:ChatAdminRights: Click existing synthetic admin row; seed member/admin/user.
management:ChatNewAdminRights: Click separate nonadmin synthetic user/member in add-admin picker.
right:PollResults: Seed message.content.pollId, global.messages.pollById, results and tab.votesByOption.
right:EditTopic: Seed selected ApiTopic and forum chat.
right:MonetizationStatistics: Seed tab monetization payload; read-only body only.

folder.preconditions: Merge byId[2], orderedIds containing2, invites[2]=[]; Create reducer reset; filters initialize temporary filters; Share initializes exact shareFolderScreen.

session.preconditions: Current and second distinct hash/isCurrent=false in actual byHash/orderedHashes,ttlDays30; no terminate action.

passkey.preconditions: Nonempty array for saved row; [] intentionally resets; no credential creation/delete/native request.

reaction.preconditions: Two active emoji entries plus config.defaultReaction; animation/staticIcon fields optional.

emojiSet.preconditions: Defined[] setIds verifies empty settings branch only; populated id+matching set verifies set row, not media catalog.

topic.preconditions: Forum chat, TopicsInfo totalCount1/listedTopicIds[1]; exact edit selectedtopic1; no save/delete.

stats.preconditions: Overview+explicit graph-error branch only; full charts require valid LovelyChartParams, not error payload.

poll.preconditions: Clone valid synthetic ApiMessage into selected CHAT_ID/byId[1], content.pollId fixture-poll; tab.pollResults chatId/messageId/votesByOption each empty[]; zero-voter body only, no vote or remote paging.
